name: sunlight-concrete-gaze
image_vibe: Quiet tension and controlled power in a sunlit concrete interior
image_purpose: Create a contemporary editorial fashion portrait with a restrained architectural mood.

prompt.project_info: A full-body editorial portrait of an original adult woman squatting in a minimalist sunlit indoor space while gathering her hair into a bun.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman in a fitted beige long-sleeve shirt, dark loose-fit cargo pants, and black athletic sneakers. She has a focused, emotionally contained expression and looks directly toward the camera while both hands gather her hair at the crown.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered full-body framing from a slightly elevated angle, deep squat with elbows raised, empty smooth concrete room, large windows, geometric light shadows across the floor, and balanced negative space.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft yet high-contrast natural daylight entering from the side windows, muted beige, warm white, charcoal, and soft gray palette, quiet introspective tension, controlled-power editorial mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens perspective, moderate depth of field, sharp subject with subtly softened background, photorealistic editorial realism, natural skin and fabric texture, high-resolution detail, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic full-body editorial portrait of an original adult woman squatting low in an empty minimalist concrete interior while gathering her hair into a bun with both hands. Dress her in a fitted beige long-sleeve shirt, dark loose-fit cargo pants, and black athletic sneakers. Use a slightly elevated camera angle, centered composition, large windows, soft geometric daylight shadows across the smooth concrete floor, a muted beige, warm white, charcoal, and gray palette, 35mm lens perspective, moderate depth of field, natural textures, controlled-power mood, high-resolution editorial realism, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, awkward squat, floating limbs, plastic skin, harsh blown highlights, text, watermark

assets.name: source sunlight concrete portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for the squat pose, concrete room, daylight geometry, muted palette, and editorial framing; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult subject, beige shirt, cargo pants, hair-gathering gesture, concrete interior, geometric daylight, and quiet editorial tension. Identity may vary.
